purpose: Round 4, integration (reading rule, rule 7; harness table: 'r4 merge of the area models'): three-way merge, file by file (git merge-file), of the three area copies' model/ against the program the round started from, 'results/S106 The written-in test taken out/model after S106/model/', by merge_models.py. Known answer, from the diffs of each copy against the base (integration notes, section 3), not from a run: 23 files; 9 changed: claims_b.py, claims_r3a3.py, claims_r4a3.py, corefile.py taken from area 3; claims_r4a2.py, core.py from area 2; claims_a.py and claims_s41.py merged clean (areas 1 and 3, hunks apart); one conflict, run.py, one hunk (area 2's and area 3's import lines, both after claims_s106's). The 14 other files are the base's. Every conflict goes to Opus (the integration, second part) whatever the checks give: which side, or what combination, is a judgement. merge_models.py writes only in the scratchpad (hcommon.guard_write), so the merged folder is {OUT}/merged/model/; Opus writes 'results/S107 Round 4 - maths after the reading/model after round 4/' from it once the conflict is resolved (model/ from the merge; the three case scripts from 'model after S106/', unchanged by every area: inputs below).
